installed.note: The ~/.local/bin/superproductivity launcher and running process use this build.

fork.note: Earlier 18.16 custom build; no longer the running application.

sample.format: bare AppDataComplete without the export envelope

rows.capability: Create, edit, complete/reopen tasks with notes, estimate and deadline
rows.data: Title, notes, completion time, creation time, estimate and date or instant deadline apply. Notes stay plain text; SP renders markdown. Estimates above 720 minutes or not in whole minutes block import.
rows.sync: Full sync v2 outbox with per-field merge.
rows.ui: Tasks page editor and Today queue.

rows.capability: Full child tasks: add, convert, move between parents, hide done/all children
rows.data: SP children are full tasks (2,493 in the September 24 backup). Tadooer subtasks are one-level checklist items; import blocks with hierarchy_parity_required rather than flattening.
rows.sync: Checklist items are cached read-only; writes are online HTTP.
rows.ui: Checklist on the Tasks page only.

rows.capability: Manual ordering, drag and drop, duplicate, multi-select bulk actions
rows.data: Project/tag taskIds ordering is retained in provenance only.
rows.sync: No rank field exists to sync.
rows.ui: Fixed newest-first list.
rows.mcp: Assistant bulk operations and approvals are #33.

rows.capability: Delete with confirmation and undo/restore
rows.data: Deleted tasks are not part of SP exports.
rows.sync: Delete and restore are queued offline.
rows.ui: Recovery list for deleted tasks.

rows.capability: Short syntax (+project, #tag, @date, !deadline, estimates, URLs), markdown and email paste
rows.data: Not import data.
rows.ui: Capture form resolves existing projects/tags; @ requires a time. No estimate syntax, tag creation, URL extraction or paste import.

rows.capability: File, link, image, command and note attachments
rows.data: Populated attachments block import.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Project lifecycle: create, rename, icon, theme, hide, archive/unarchive, complete/reopen, delete
rows.data: Identity and title apply. Icon, theme, visibility and worklog settings are retained in provenance. Archived or completed projects block import.
rows.sync: Read cache only; writes are online HTTP.
rows.ui: Create, assign and filter on the Tasks page; no unarchive, colour or completion.

rows.capability: Per-project backlog with move to/from regular list
rows.data: Populated backlogTaskIds block import; isEnableBacklog is retained.
rows.ui: Inbox is a filter, not a backlog.

rows.capability: Tags with colour, icon, theme, ordering; Urgent/Important system tags
rows.data: Identity and title apply; colour, icon and theme are retained in provenance. The virtual TODAY tag blocks import.
rows.sync: Read cache only; writes are online HTTP.
rows.ui: Create, assign and filter; no colour or archive UI.

rows.capability: Standalone project notes: markdown, pin to Today, reorder, move
rows.data: Populated note stores, project noteIds and project/tag notes block import.
rows.ui: Task notes only.

rows.capability: Sidebar folders and ordering for projects and tags
rows.data: Reported as configuration and not applied.
rows.ui: Fixed navigation.

rows.capability: Today list from day-only plans, plan tasks and deadline tasks for today, remove from Today
rows.data: Day-only dueDay blocks import because plannedStart is an instant.
rows.sync: plannedStart is not in queued sync operations.
rows.ui: Derived Today queue: overdue, scheduled today, unscheduled. No explicit selection.

rows.capability: Schedule with date/time, per-task and deadline reminders, snooze, reminder dialog actions
rows.data: dueWithTime applies as plannedStart. remindAt, deadlineRemindAt, legacy reminderId/plannedAt and the legacy reminders store block import.
rows.sync: Server-side durable delivery; not an offline client concern.
rows.ui: Fixed 15-minute and at-start notifications from plannedStart only.

rows.capability: Multi-day planner: drag between days, inline add, overdue column, repeat projections
rows.data: Planner day ordering is reported as configuration; the day itself comes from dueDay.
rows.ui: Day, three-day and week views without drag and drop.

rows.capability: Timeline with work hours, lunch break, calendar events, split tasks, drag to reschedule
rows.data: Work-hour preferences live in globalConfig (configuration).
rows.sync: Time blocks are online HTTP writes to Baikal.
rows.ui: Calm day plus one time block per task; no drag, month view or splitting.

rows.capability: Repeat configurations: daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, Nth weekday, pause, wait for completion, skip overdue, delete instance, subtask templates
rows.data: 49 repeat configurations in the September 24 backup; import blocks with recurrence_parity_required.
rows.ui: Habits are separate and must not substitute.

rows.capability: Archive done tasks, view and restore archived tasks, young/old archive tiers
rows.data: 4,269 archived tasks in the September 24 backup; archives block apply.
rows.ui: Completed tasks stay in the active list.

rows.capability: Finish day summary, end-of-day notes, plan tomorrow, finish-day prompt
rows.data: Daily summary note lives in globalConfig (configuration).
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Track time per task and day, estimate overrun, round time, add time for another day, context work start/end/breaks
rows.data: timeSpent/timeSpentOnDay block with time_history_parity_required; context work-day records block as unsupported_section.
rows.sync: Focus sessions are server-authoritative; intervals are not aggregated.
rows.ui: Focus panel without elapsed or spent totals.

rows.capability: Worklog/history by year, month, week; inline correction; CSV export
rows.data: Worklog export settings are retained in project advancedCfg.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Pomodoro, Flowtime and Countdown sessions with breaks, sounds and session logging
rows.data: Focus preferences are configuration; logged sessions live in metric.
rows.sync: Server-authoritative session with explicit multi-device takeover.
rows.ui: Start, pause, resume, break and complete; no cycle presets or durations.
rows.mcp: focus.start, pause, resume, start_break, end_break, complete, takeover.

rows.capability: Idle detection with time assignment, take-a-break reminders, tracking reminder
rows.data: Configuration only.
rows.ui: Scheduled break window only suppresses reminders.

rows.capability: Boards with filtered panels, Eisenhower and Kanban defaults, drag between panels
rows.data: Board definitions are reported as configuration.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Named sections inside project and tag lists
rows.data: Populated sections block import.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Sort, group and filter task lists per context
rows.data: Stored in SP localStorage; not in exports.
rows.ui: Search, status, project and tag filters; no grouping or sort choice.

rows.capability: Daily evaluation, focus session log, productivity and sustainability scores, charts
rows.data: 80 metric days in the September 24 backup block import.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Click counters, stopwatches, countdown reminders, habit streaks and weekly grid
rows.data: Counter definitions are configuration; recorded counts block import. Tadooer habits do not store numeric daily values.
rows.sync: Habit commands are sync v2 operations.
rows.ui: Habits page with streaks; no counters or stopwatches.
rows.mcp: habits.list, habits.mutate; super-productivity-mcp counter tools have no equivalent.

rows.capability: Issue providers (Jira, GitLab, GitHub, Gitea, Linear and others): search, backlog import, polling, two-way sync, Jira worklogs
rows.data: Provider configuration (17 instances, 13 Gitea) is reported, never applied, and must not import credentials. Linked task fields block import.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Calendar subscriptions, events in planner/schedule, event-to-task, auto-import, hidden events, time blocks
rows.data: Calendar provider instances are part of issueProvider configuration.
rows.ui: Baikal and read-only Google events, ICS import/export, one time block per task. No iCal URL subscriptions or event-to-task.

rows.capability: In-app plugin runtime: install, enable, configuration, hooks, synced plugin data, UI injection
rows.data: Plugin user data blocks import; plugin enablement is configuration. plugins/tadooer is an assistant package, not a runtime.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Feature toggles, task, time-tracking, reminder, schedule, sound and misc preferences
rows.data: globalConfig is reported as configuration and not applied.
rows.sync: Planning and notification preferences are server-side.
rows.ui: Planning, notification, connection and sync settings.

rows.capability: About 60 configurable shortcuts plus desktop global shortcuts
rows.data: Configuration.
rows.ui: Ctrl/Cmd+K command bar only.

rows.capability: Dark/light/system theme, custom themes, backgrounds, language, first day of week, locale
rows.data: Configuration.
rows.ui: English only; no theme toggle.

rows.capability: Onboarding presets and guided tour
rows.data: Not import data.
rows.ui: Owner setup only.

rows.capability: Tray, floating task widget, minimize to tray, custom title bar
rows.data: Per-device settings are not exported.
rows.ui: Constrained desktop shell without tray or widget.

rows.capability: See and stop another device's active tracking
rows.data: Ephemeral in SP; not exported.
rows.ui: Focus panel shows controller state.

rows.capability: Multi-device sync through Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, local file, Nextcloud or SuperSync, with optional end-to-end encryption
rows.data: Sync credentials are not exported.
rows.sync: Tadooer uses a self-hosted server with an offline outbox (ADR 0010). Third-party storage providers and client-side encryption are not planned.
rows.ui: Sync now and health in Settings.

rows.capability: Offline edits for every entity
rows.data: Not import data.
rows.sync: Only tasks (without plannedStart, project and tags) and habits queue offline.
rows.ui: Online-only controls elsewhere.

rows.capability: Full JSON export/import, automatic local backups, restore, privacy export
rows.data: Preview classifies every section and task field; apply is core-only and transactional.
rows.sync: Imported records enter the normal task store.
rows.ui: Preview and apply on Connections.

rows.capability: User-facing export and restore of Tadooer data
rows.data: Operator SQLite backup CLI only.
rows.ui: None.

rows.capability: Local REST API, URL-scheme actions and the super-productivity-mcp tool catalog
rows.data: Not import data.
rows.sync: Automation uses the same server authority.
rows.ui: Assistant access on Connections.
rows.mcp: Scoped catalog; counters, recurrence, worklog, bulk and project/tag writes from the 55 super-productivity-mcp tools remain open (#32, #55-#59).

rows.capability: Android widget, foreground tracking notification, native reminders, quick actions
rows.data: Not import data.
rows.ui: Responsive web and ntfy notifications only.
